```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(magrittr)

library(BPCells)
parent_dir <- "./mb_neuron_human_rosmap_dataset/"

## ---- 2. Find all run directories ----
run_dirs <- list.dirs(parent_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
names(run_dirs) <- basename(run_dirs)

## ---- 3. Load each directory with ReadSTARsolo into a named list ----
##   data.dir points straight at the folder holding matrix.mtx/barcodes.tsv/features.tsv
mat_list <- lapply(run_dirs, function(d) ReadSTARsolo(data.dir = d))
names(mat_list) <- names(run_dirs)

## ---- 4. Pull the sample number (S#) out of each folder name ----
extract_sample <- function(folder) {
  parts <- strsplit(folder, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  s <- parts[grepl("^S[0-9]+$", parts)]      # matches the S3 token, not an S inside a name
  if (length(s) == 0) NA_character_ else s[[1]]
}
sample_id <- vapply(names(mat_list), extract_sample, character(1))


if (any(is.na(sample_id))) {
  warning("No S# token found in: ",
          paste(names(mat_list)[is.na(sample_id)], collapse = ", "))
}


## ---- 6. Group by sample number, sum within each group, and prefix cell names ----
groups <- split(mat_list, sample_id)

for(i in 1:length(groups)) {
  cur_sample = names(groups)[i]
  for(j in 1:length(groups[[cur_sample]])) {
    cur_colnames = colnames(groups[[cur_sample]][[j]])
    colnames_with_sample = paste0(cur_sample,"_",cur_colnames)
    colnames(groups[[cur_sample]][[j]]) = colnames_with_sample
  }
}



first = T
for(i in 1:length(groups)) {
  cur_sample = names(groups)[i]
  for(j in 1:length(groups[[cur_sample]])) {
    cur_sample_mat = groups[[cur_sample]][[j]] %>%  as("IterableMatrix")
    if(first == T) {
      bpcells_mat = cur_sample_mat
      first = F
    } else{
      #cells profiled in both aggregate mat and cur mat 
      shared_cells = intersect(cur_sample_mat %>% colnames, bpcells_mat %>% colnames) 
      if(length(shared_cells) > 0) {
        if(!all(rownames(cur_sample_mat) == rownames(bpcells_mat))) stop()
      
        combined_mat_shared_cells <- cur_sample_mat[, shared_cells] + bpcells_mat[, shared_cells]
      
        new_cells   <- setdiff(colnames(cur_sample_mat), shared_cells)  # only in this lane
        other_cells <- setdiff(colnames(bpcells_mat),   shared_cells)   # already accumulated
      
        pieces <- list(combined_mat_shared_cells)
        if(length(new_cells)   > 0) pieces <- c(pieces, list(cur_sample_mat[, new_cells]))
        if(length(other_cells) > 0) pieces <- c(pieces, list(bpcells_mat[,  other_cells]))
      
        bpcells_mat <- if(length(pieces) == 1) pieces[[1]] else Reduce(cbind, pieces)
      
      } else {
        bpcells_mat <- cbind(bpcells_mat, cur_sample_mat)
      } 
    }
  }
}


write_matrix_dir(bpcells_mat,"combined_bpcells_mat")

```
